# Active Chromewell Exhaust Pvt Ltd

> Active Chromewell Exhaust is a world-class joint venture provider of exhaust and emissions solutions, including thermal management technologies for off-highway vehicles, equipment applications, and gasoline, diesel, and stationary engines.

## About
Established in 2013 as a joint venture between Active Exhaust Corporation (North America, est. 1958) and Chromewell Engineering Limited (India, est. 1958). Located in the Sanaswadi industrial area near Pune, Maharashtra, India. ISO 9001 and TS16949 certified.

## Core Offerings
- Exhaust and emissions solutions
- Thermal management technologies
- Broad metal fabrication capabilities for global OEMs

## Key Clients
John Deere, Kubota, Polaris, Wacker Neuson, Club Car, Doosan, Toro, CNH, CAT, Carraro, Force Motors, LiuGong, and Ajax Fiori.
